metadata.title: haruka sample
metadata.concept: Someone deciding to leave, in the quiet minute before anyone notices.

characters.identity: silver ponytail, calm grey eyes, teal field jacket over a white shirt, brass star pendant

globalStyle.grade: cool shadows, warm practical lights, light grain

shots.idea: Open on the place, not the person — establish the empty room she is about to leave
shots.action: Late afternoon light moves slowly across an empty apartment
shots.heroMotion: dust drifting in a shaft of light
shots.audioSync: fade in on the first pad chord

source.prompt: An empty small apartment in late afternoon, warm orange light through a west-facing window, a packed travel bag by the door, dust drifting in the light, no people, no characters, empty room, clean modern anime illustration style, vertical composition

shots.idea: Introduce her small against the space — she has already decided
shots.subject: @haruka
shots.action: She stands in the doorway looking back into the room one last time
shots.heroMotion: she shifts the bag strap on her shoulder
shots.audioSync: cut in on the first downbeat

source.prompt: The exact same character from Picture 1, same silver ponytail, same teal field jacket, full body wide shot, standing in an apartment doorway with a travel bag over her shoulder, looking back into the warm empty room behind her, clean modern anime illustration style, vertical composition

shots.idea: Closer — let the face carry the doubt the wide shot could not
shots.subject: @haruka
shots.action: She looks down at the key in her hand, then closes her fist around it
shots.heroMotion: her hand closes around the key

source.prompt: The exact same character from Picture 1, same face, same silver ponytail and teal jacket, chest-up medium close-up, looking down at a brass key held in her open hand, warm side light, soft focus background, clean modern anime illustration style, vertical composition

lyric.text: I already know the way out

shots.idea: The detail shot that says goodbye without her face — cut away before it gets sentimental
shots.action: The key is left on the kitchen counter, catching the last of the light
shots.heroMotion: the key settles on the counter
shots.audioSync: on the kick, end of the line

source.prompt: Macro insert shot of a single brass key resting on a pale kitchen counter, warm late afternoon light raking across the surface, shallow depth of field, no people, no characters, object close-up only, clean modern anime illustration style, vertical composition

shots.idea: Outside, and the scale of the world opens up — new chain, new framing
shots.subject: @haruka
shots.action: She walks out into a wide street at dusk, city lights coming on ahead of her

source.prompt: The exact same character from Picture 1, same silver ponytail and teal field jacket, seen from behind, full body wide shot, walking away down a wide city street at dusk with a travel bag over her shoulder, warm street lights coming on ahead of her, cool blue sky above, clean modern anime illustration style, vertical composition

shots.idea: Continuation of the same take — the walk keeps going, motion carries across the cut
shots.subject: @haruka
shots.action: She keeps walking, the street widening around her
shots.heroMotion: steady walk, jacket moving in the wind

source.prompt: She keeps walking away down the dusk street, steady pace, city lights brightening ahead

shots.idea: One last look back at the camera — the only time she faces us
shots.subject: @haruka
shots.action: She glances back over her shoulder, almost smiling, then turns away
shots.heroMotion: she turns her head back, then away again

source.prompt: The exact same character from Picture 1, same face, same silver ponytail and teal jacket, chest-up medium close-up, glancing back over her shoulder toward the camera with a faint almost-smile, warm street lights behind her at dusk, clean modern anime illustration style, vertical composition

shots.idea: End on the world without her in it — mirrors the opening shot
shots.action: The empty street holds for a moment after she has gone
shots.heroMotion: traffic lights change in the distance
shots.audioSync: let the last chord ring out, fade to black

source.prompt: A wide empty city street at night, warm street lights and a distant traffic light, wet asphalt reflecting the lights, no people, no characters, empty scene, clean modern anime illustration style, vertical composition
